d: Nitish kumar ke bihar ke mukhyamantri ke rup men 21 sal pure hone ke uplakshy men janta dal yunaited (JD(U)) ne rajdhani patna sthit apne pradesh karyalay men 'sushasan divas' manaya. ullekhniy hai ki 24 navanbar 2005 ko nitish kumar ne pahli bar bihar ke mukhyamantri ke rup men apne purn karyakal ki shuruaat ki thi, jiske 21 varsh pure hone par parti ki or se yah vishesh aayojan kiya gaya. pradesh karyalay men vishesh karyakram, parti ke neta aur karyakarta hue shamil:patna sthit JD(U) pradesh karyalay men aayojit is karyakram men parti ke varishth neta, padadhikari aur bari sankhya men…
